title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E04 — The Nose Knows Best
K9s save the day, identifying gallons of paint and beer bottles filled with more than the officers bargained for; a man with a warrant for his arrest is concealing something suspicious; officers question the intentions of a chatty traveler.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E09 — The Hitman
Agricultural inspectors intercept nearly 50 gallons of illicit moonshine; a former cartel hitman is extradited back to Mexico; a random vehicle inspection turns up a major seizure; a woman is caught attempting to smuggle prescription meds.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:

When an X-ray reveals strange shapes inside a car's spare tire, the officers' investigation doesn't turn up flat; a group of unofficial couriers known as Paqueteros attempts to cross the border with something a little extra in their load.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E04 — Judge, Jury and Executioner
A Canadian national finds himself in hot water for illegally working for his uncle in the U.S.; a man tries crossing while carrying cosmetic injections stuffed into a sweet treat; a rookie officer follows a hunch after a trend of narcotics smuggling.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S07 E02 — Oh Brother, Not Another
When a man is detained on a warrant, the mug shot confirms they have the correct man, but his fingerprints aren't a match; a woman arrives at the border driving an oil worker's truck; upon inspection, officers find white powder around the opening.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:

Unrelenting rainfall in central Texas turns the Fourth of July into a fight for survival.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E02 — Mile-Wide EF5
Six teams of chasers pursue a violent tornado outbreak in North Dakota; but as day turns to night, the storm unleashes the first EF5 tornado in over a decade; as the mile-wide monster levels homes and farms, chasers race to rescue people and pets.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers

Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

description:

description:

Jamie and Adam test if a person with no flight training can safely land an airplane; Hollywood-inspired sky-diving myths.

title: MythBusters

Adam and Jamie test the physics theory of bullet dropped vs. bullet fired; Kari, Grant and Tory test if it's possible to knock someone's socks off.

The team examines viral videos from the internet; they try to find out if people truly believe what they see.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S05 E05 — All the Pretty Gold
Two miners in MT desperately need to double their gold after a disastrous start to the season; battling a personal crisis, Juan rejoins Freddy as they follow signs of old mining tunnels and use new technology to uncover ancient river channel gold.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S05 E07 — The Jig Is Up
Constant shutdowns and a complicated wash plant threaten to destroy a BC family's $1.2 million mining investment; when a personal crisis turns the rescue into a one-man mission, Juan must pull off a masterclass in jig upgrades to get the gold.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E01 — Great Klondike Gold Hunt
In the Yukon, Freddy and Juan tackle their most extensive treasure hunt yet; 288 claims across 6,000 acres and double the breakdowns; as the seconds tick away on the miner's season, the duo teams up with a local expert to find the gold.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E06 — It's a Hard-Rock Life
In California, a miner with 75 cents in the bank faces ruin at his failing hard-rock mine; when a pivot to placer mining fails, Freddy makes an incredible discovery, and Juan builds their first-ever hard-rock mill hammer system to save this dad.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E09 — Taming the Monster
Freddy and Juan find a struggling miner who put his entire life savings into 288 claims in Arizona to create a legacy for his grandson.

title: Gold Rush
description:

Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Gold Rush
description:

Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

description:
S01 E05 — Virginia Beach Correctional
Virginia Beach is a party town with a vibrant nightlife, making its Correctional Center one of the busiest city jails in the state; here, some inmates arrive to go on vacation, then leave on probation, and return on a violation.

Behind the walls of Clayton County Jail, deteriorating infrastructure creates dangerous conditions for both inmates and staff.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:

In Clay County, Mississippi, where gun deaths are an epidemic and the median income sits 66% below the national average, Sheriff Scott and his team fight to keep order inside a jail where the consequences of a community in crisis arrive daily.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E12 — Loudoun County Adult Detention Center
In one of America's wealthiest counties, Loudoun County Adult Detention Center serves the wealthy and the impoverished alike by running rehab programs, chasing contraband, and giving every inmate — rich or poor — a shot at a brighter future.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S02 E03 — Family Secrets
The truth about serial killer H.H. Holmes's death may be exposed by one of his descendants; did the government conspire with the mafia about a mysterious helicopter crash?

title: Expedition Files
description:

Josh examines clues left by the Zodiac Killer, the location of Forrest Fenn's million-dollar buried treasure, and the Voynich Manuscript.

title: Expedition Files

A real-life child whose possession inspired "The Exorcist"; a con artist leaves a trail of deception and perhaps, even murder; an ancient army is defeated by hallucinogenic honey; these three stories prove that truth can outmatch fiction.

title: Expedition Files
description:

Josh Gates investigates three aquatic mysteries: the Kraken, Lake Lanier and Atlantis; from terrifying sailor lore, to a deadly lake's dark past and a lost city beneath the sea, he searches for evidence.

Jess and Phil venture deep into the Ozarks to investigate a mysterious predatory beast; eyewitnesses, surveillance footage and new recordings of bone-chilling howls lead the team to a shocking revelation about the legendary creature.

Hollywood gives audiences plenty of hero cars they can drive home, Knight Rider, the DeLorean, even Herbie, but the Batmobile is always out of reach; of all its incarnations, no other machine redefined the movie car more than the 1989 Batmobile.

A garage-built experiment turns a cultural icon, the Meyers Manx dune buggy, which makes car building accessible to the masses; its success unleashes a flood of copycats that nearly wiped out the very garage that started it all.

description:
S15 E04 — Bro, Hold My Fear
Four male survivalists who tapped in previous challenges seek redemption in South Africa; humbled by their past failures, they hope to survive 21 days and triumph as a tribe.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S16 E05 — Odd Man Out
Three women attempt to survive 21 days in Zambia; when their fourth partner arrives unexpectedly, the all-female dynamic is shattered.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E07 — Taste of Their Own Medicine
For the first time ever, two Naked and Afraid crew members attempt to survive 21 days in front of the camera. But faced with swarms of unrelenting insects and a lack of food, this history-making duo is about to get a taste of their own medicine.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E10 — Not Today, Satan
Two survivalists attempt to endure 21 days in Mexico's Devil's Canyon, a notorious hellscape where no one else has managed to make it past one week.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:

A survivalist postpones her wedding to try to make it to 21 days with a British commando in the mosquito-infested Colombian tropics.

description:

When wind-driven fires explode across Los Angeles in January 2025, cameras capture chaos and heroism as residents attempt to rescue loved ones and flee burning neighborhoods.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E04 — Half-Country Hurricane
Showcasing how Hurricane Ida hit the Louisiana coast in 2021 and features films from eyewitnesses as tornadoes and flooding hit all the way to New York City.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S01 E06 — Texas Tornado
When a tornado outbreak strikes Texas and Kansas in 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses find themselves trapped in the path; as they seek the best shelter they can find, they capture the moments when tornadoes destroy the very structures around them.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E13 — Three Rivers, Four Tornadoes
A lone supercell thunderstorm in March 2026 spawns unexpected late winter tornadoes in the upper Midwest, including the earliest-ever EF-3 tornado to hit Michigan.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E14 — EF-4 vs. Air Force Base
In April 2026, tornadoes rip through northern Oklahoma, forcing residents to take cover. As the outbreak reaches its peak, a massive EF-4 touches down near the town of Enid, striking Vance Air Force Base before tearing through a nearby neighborhood.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E06 — Flood of the Century
When a freak storm unleashes a tornado and a year's worth of rainfall on the city of Valencia, Spain, eyewitnesses capture catastrophic flooding in the urban center; bridges buckle, cars are swept away and residents fight for their lives.
